mapper.select: SELECT seat_id, room_id, row_name, col_num, is_active FROM seats WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND is_active = TRUE ORDER BY row_name ASC, col_num ASC
SELECT bs.seat_id FROM booked_seats bs JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id = bs.booking_id WHERE bs.screening_id = #{screeningId} AND b.booking_status = 'DONE'
